description: This Java class 'CmpMergeTool' provides a command-line utility to merge multiple '.cmp' KiCad component mapping files into a single output file. It reads input files, skips headers and footers, and writes the combined content into a specified destination file, adding a header and footer.

classes.name: CmpMergeTool
classes.description: A utility class with a main method that performs merging of component map files based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The program entry point that processes input arguments, reads source files, and writes merged content to the destination file.
